identity: Mournfen's barrows hold the oldest remembered dead of the Throng; the fen keeps rising, bandits loot the barrows and the mirefolk count stolen bones as wages.

quests.title: A Name Above the Mud
quests.text: The old grave markers are rotting, and the rain has no gift for remembering names. Bring me six Wooden Signs to replace them. I have kept these burials in order for too long to let damp wood have the final word.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Before the Letters Go
quests.text: There are still readable names on the damaged marker at the {name:name_rest}, {dir_from_giver:name_rest}, in the {name:blightfields}. Copy them and bring your findings to me before another rain makes strangers of the people buried there. Take care with the letters; someone once took care to put them there.
quests.completion: I can match these names to the burials again. The rain may have the wood in time, but it will not have the only record.

objectives.label: Copy the names from the marker

quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: What Leaves the Fen
quests.text: Some graves have lost more than their markings. Speak to Sera Vane at Mournfen Outpost and tell her that remains are missing from the burials I tend. She watches the loads leaving the fen; I should like to know which of my neighbours have been put among them.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Path That Stays Put
quests.text: The fen moves its edges while we sleep, and a trail that held yesterday may swallow a boot today. Bring me twelve whole logs of any tree from outside the settlements, and I will cut stakes for the safe paths. Following a transport is easier when I am not also retrieving my feet.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Light for the Late Return
quests.text: Some people come back from the graves very late, and I would rather they had light than company from the mud. Bring me twenty Torches for the paths. Grief is quite enough to carry without a broken ankle.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Leave the Buried Be
quests.text: The Plague Tuskers are rooting through graves I have already put in order once. Kill seven by day in the {name:barrowfields}, which lie {zone_area:barrowfields}. I am a patient keeper, but I refuse to schedule every burial twice.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Keep the Name with It
quests.text: A recovered possession tells us very little once someone separates it from its owner's name. Bring me two Locked Chests so I can keep the belongings and their records together. The people who come to claim them deserve more than a guess.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: What Hollis Saw
quests.text: Hollis Grey is being held in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, where he has seen remains carried away in sacks. Go and hear what he can tell you. I can follow a cart's tracks, but Hollis can tell me what was put on it.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Close {name:reed_counter_silt}'s Account
quests.text: I watched them trade sacks of remains for beads, while Mirefolk Reed-Counter Silt counted the bones as neatly as any merchant counts stock. Kill him at the {name:mire_nests}, {dir_from_giver:mire_nests}, and report to Sera Vane at Mournfen Outpost. The sacks made them easy to carry; they did not make them any less people.
quests.completion: The Reed-Counter is down; I will put that in the report beside Hollis's account. I will also keep every name we can establish with the remains, however little use the trader had for them.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Gaps in the Register
quests.text: Remains are leaving Mournfen without their names, and the gaps in the burial records grow with every load. Take that report to Ossa Quietregister in Nhal Veyr. Tell her we need to know who claims the right to take them, before another neighbour becomes an unlabelled sack.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).

quests.title: My Word for Yours
quests.text: The iron and jade orders are filled; I have set your name down carefully, with my word beside it. Take my recommendation to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr; The Oathdelvers should know who helped us.
quests.completion: Your name is legible, and the foreman has put his own beside it. I will preserve that recommendation among the reliable helpers of The Oathdelvers.
